name: Milena Petrović
bio:
Milena discovered her passion for composite materials while working on aircraft components in Belgrade during her early career. The precision and lightness of carbon fiber fascinated her, leading her to pursue specialized training in motorsport composites. She joined a small racing team initially, learning the ropes from seasoned veterans, before moving into Formula racing as a composite fabricator.

Milena's meticulous approach is her trademark. She insists on triple-checking every layup and cure cycle, believing that even the smallest imperfection can compromise performance and safety. Her calm demeanor and ability to think strategically make her an invaluable asset, especially during high-pressure race weekends. She sees the big picture, understanding how her work impacts the overall performance of the team. She is also known to be a mentor to younger technicians, passing on her knowledge and experience to the next generation.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, often pulled back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: A stout woman with a strong, determined face and kind eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and notes.
Insists on using a specific brand of sealant, believing it provides a superior bond.
Frequently hums traditional Serbian folk songs while working, especially when under pressure.
